rendered.overview: [[Avatar Aang // Aang, Master of Elements]] leads a five-color airbending deck built around Lesson spells and bending. Its lands make every color except black, so black comes from [[Arcane Signet]] or [[Chromatic Lantern]]. The commander is expected around turn 3. Airbend and bending actions draw cards and exile nonland permanents to recast for {2}, while Lesson spells fill the graveyard for late payoffs like [[Bumi, King of Three Trials]]. The backup win is a loop of [[Aang, the Last Airbender]], [[Appa, Steadfast Guardian]] and the commander producing infinite creature tokens.

strategy: Cast [[Avatar Aang // Aang, Master of Elements]] around turn 3, then airbend and bend permanents to draw cards.
Airbend nonland permanents with [[Appa, Steadfast Guardian]] and [[Aang, the Last Airbender]] when they enter the battlefield.
Lesson spells such as [[Airbending Lesson]] feed the bending draw and fill the graveyard for [[Bumi, King of Three Trials]].
Backup: [[Aang, Swift Savior // Aang and La, Ocean's Fury]] with [[Appa, Steadfast Guardian]] and the commander loops for infinite creature tokens.

keep: [[Appa, Steadfast Guardian]] with a ramp piece starts the airbend chain.
Early [[Shared Roots]] fetches a basic to feed the commander.
sendBack: Without ramp or an airbend creature, the hand has no early line.

tips.text: [[Appa, Steadfast Guardian]] airbends your other permanents on entry, and [[Aang, the Last Airbender]] airbends one more on entry.

cards: Avatar Aang // Aang, Master of Elements
tips.text: [[Airbending Lesson]] airbends a permanent, and each airbend under [[Avatar Aang // Aang, Master of Elements]] draws a card.
[[Chromatic Lantern]] makes your lands tap for any color, and [[Arcane Signet]] adds any color in the commander's identity.

weaknesses: Moderate: [[Bojuka Bog]] empties the graveyard that Lesson-count payoffs like [[Bumi, King of Three Trials]] depend on.
Moderate: Only 1 of its 2 interaction cards works at instant speed, so [[Splinter Twin]] can resolve unanswered.
Moderate: Without the commander the bending draws stop, and [[Swords to Plowshares]] exiles it on sight.
